title: UserAction
description: A sign-in waits for a person: open the verification page and enter the code. The code is sent here and nowhere else — in no progress line, no log record and no diagnostic.

verificationUri.description: The page where the person enters the code.

verificationUriComplete.description: The page with the code already in it, when the issuer offers one.

expiresInSeconds.description: How long the code is good for, from when it was issued.
